title: Seven Winters and One Short Map
subtitle: 文学写作 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 文学写作（人与社会·文学、艺术与体育）
meta: 主题语境：文学写作（人与社会·文学、艺术与体育）　|　核心词汇：fantasy　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 fantasy 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1967 my aunt ① wrote a fantasy that no teacher in the school would have read, and she said the writing was the whole of the winter. The ② fantasy, meaning the tale itself and not the fact, ran seven winters and stayed unread in the book; a fantasy, she said, is the only thing in a school that is judged by how long it is left unread.

Every ③ fantasy in that school had the same short map beside it, and the ④ fantasy at the far side, meaning the one they kept for the children and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A fantasy, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to read; my aunt said the reading is the part that fills seven winters.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the fantasy was the whole of the plan, meaning the dream and not the tale. The ⑥ fantasy, meaning the dream and not any of that, is the only thing in a plan that everybody waits for and nobody reads; fantasy, he said, is either something you write or the only word that means both a tale and a dream. He said the dream is the part they remember.

By 1974 the ⑦ fantasy had become a line in a notebook, and the notebook had become an argument about the short map. The ⑧ fantasy of the whole thing, my aunt wrote in January, was one school and seven winters of reading; fantasy, she said, is either the one at the far side or the reason you learned to read. She said the reading was never mentioned.

The ⑨ fantasy I remember is the one read in the notebook, which closed in 1977 and is still described as the quietest in the school. A ⑩ fantasy, my mother said in 1979, is the only one that improves by being read; every fantasy, she said, is a dream that has agreed to look like a tale. She said the dream was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 幻想小说；奇幻故事（指学校里每一篇旁边的那一篇）
B. n. 幻想作品（指那一篇本身，与事实相对）
C. 固定搭配：write a fantasy 写一篇幻想作品
D. n. 幻想作品（指留给孩子的那一篇）
E. n. 幻想（抽象总称，指一所学校的想象之事）
F. n. 幻想作品（指本子上写到、被读到的那一篇）
G. n. 幻想；空想（指一份计划里人人都等却无人读到的那样东西）
H. n. 空想（抽象总称，指人人都等却无人读到的那样东西）

items.q: wrote a fantasy that no teacher in the school would have read
The fantasy, meaning the tale itself and not the fact
the fantasy at the far side
the fantasy was the whole of the plan
the fantasy had become a line in a notebook
The fantasy of the whole thing
A fantasy, my mother said in 1979

answers.why: write a fantasy 意为“写一篇幻想作品”，1967 年姑姑写了一篇学校里没有一位老师肯读的幻想作品。
fantasy 意为“幻想作品”，指那一篇本身而不是事实，它经过了七个冬天而在簿子上没有记号。
fantasy 意为“幻想小说”，指学校里每一篇旁边的那一篇，每一篇旁边都有同一张短短的地图。
fantasy 意为“幻想作品”，指留给孩子的那一篇，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
fantasy 意为“幻想、空想”，指一份计划里人人都等却无人读到的那样东西，叔叔说这份空想就是那份计划的全部。
fantasy 意为“空想”，指人人都等却无人读到的那样东西而不是那一篇作品，是计划里人人都等、却无人读到的东西。
fantasy 意为“幻想作品”，指本子上写到、被读到的那一篇，到 1974 年这一篇成了本子里的一行。
fantasy 意为“幻想”，姑姑一月写道，整件事的想象之事是一所学校和七个冬天的读到。
fantasy 意为“幻想作品”，我记得的是本子上读到的那一篇，1977 年结束了，至今仍被说成学校里最安静的一篇。
fantasy 为抽象总称，母亲 1979 年说，一篇幻想作品是唯一会因为被好好读到而变得更好的东西。
